headline: BLANCANEVES EN EL TEATRO MUNICIPAL
content: Blancanieves en el Teatro Municipal El Ballet Municipal de Lima presenta la historia de Blancanieves en el Teatro Municipal de Lima. headline: ¿QUÉ SON LAS BLANKETS?
content: Blankets, también llamadas parkas deportivas, vuelven a ser protagonistas en la moda urbana. Durante los próximos meses, esperamos ver más modelos inspirados en décadas pasadas adaptándose a nuevas necesidades urbanas.

headline: EL PADRE LUÍS GASPAR ORGANIZADOR DE LA VISITA DEL SUMO PONTÍFIICE AL PERÚ CONFIRMÓ HOY QUE LAS PALMAS SON DESCARTADAS COMO BASE PARA LA MISIÓN PAPIAL.
content: Las Palmas have been ruled out as a site for Pope Franciss mass during his upcoming trip to Peru. Father Luís Gaspar confirmed today that Las Palmas, being a military base, isn’t suitable since it doesn’t align with tradition nor does it fall under the Archdiocese of Lima jurisdiction. Instead, preparations continue along the coast near Panama North or South roads where extensive open areas exist closer to city limits.

headline: CONTINUA SIN DEFINIRSE DONDE SERÁ LA MISA PAPIAL.
content: It remains undecided where Pope Francis will hold Mass upon visiting Lima next January. While initial plans favored locations around Coastal Green, recent discussions suggest alternatives such as expansive plains towards either side of the Pan-American Highway might offer better logistics given their proximity to major routes.

headline: PENDIENTE DE DECISIONES FINALES SOBRE LOCALIZACIÓN DE LA MULTITUDES MASSA PAPAL.
content: Final decisions regarding the location of Pope Franciss large-scale Papal Mass remain pending until further notice. Discussions involve potential sites including coastal regions initially proposed versus other options still under consideration based on logistical evaluations conducted jointly between Vatican representatives, Conference Episcopalian authorities, and the Archbishopric of Lima.
